summary: Implemented the built-in Gizmo `display` Pi tool with a shared validator in `packages/protocol/src/display.ts`, registered it alongside memory-journal, and wired the optional input dialog through the existing `ctx.ui` API (no new transport). The tool emits the display envelope via `onUpdate` before awaiting user input, returns `{status:'submitted',value}` or `{status:'cancelled'}`, and errors explicitly on headless runs that request input. Fixed several TypeScript test compilation issues, added validator tests, and verified with focused vitest runs (23 protocol tests + 13 tool tests passing) plus `tsc` and file-length checks.
decisions: Shared display parser/types live in `packages/protocol/src/display.ts` and are re-exported via `packages/protocol/src/index.ts`; tool backend lives in `apps/agent-server/src/pi-extensions/display.ts`.

Display envelope shape: `tool details.gizmoDisplay = { version:1, title?, spec }`; final result adds `response: { status:'submitted', value } | { status:'cancelled' }` and textual result must include the input response for the agent.
Tool publishes spec via `onUpdate` BEFORE awaiting `ctx.ui.input/select/confirm` so the chart/card appears while the input dialog waits; no input means immediate completion.
Headless `ctx.hasUI === false` returns an explicit error when input is requested, rather than hanging; abort signal settles the tool with `cancelled` even if the UI never responds.
`confirm` returning `false` is treated as cancelled/No-or-dismissed and documented as such (indistinguishable from cancel).
Strict validation rejects arbitrary HTML/actions/dynamic expressions via TypeBox `strict` schemas and bounded JSON budgets (envelope parsing budget 70_000 chars / 11_000 entries).
Built-in registration wired via the factory's `additionalExtensionPaths` alongside `journalExtensionPath()`, with `before_agent_start` guidance exposing the `display` tool description and contract.
Test mocks cast UI-only context to `ExtensionContext` via `unknown`; exposure tests pass the factory's `cwd` through to `beforeAgentStart` rather than reading it off the session.
errors: Initial `tsc` failed with 5 errors in display tests: `cwd` missing on `AgentSession` in exposure tests, mock `ExtensionContext` cast incompatibility, `.details?.gizmoDisplay`/`.details?.response` property access on `{}`, and `Promise.withResolvers` missing under the current TS lib target. Fixed by returning `{session, cwd}` from the build helper, casting mock through `unknown`, asserting via `toMatchObject`, and (per the file) using a polyfill-friendly resolver pattern.
